hook: Procore just launched Magpie 3.0, an AI engine that finished 78 percent of 200 construction tasks.

sections.voiceover: Procore just launched Magpie 3.0, an AI engine that finished 78 percent of 200 construction tasks.
sections.visual_cue: Bar chart showing 78 percent completion rate for 200 tasks.

sections.voiceover: At Groundbreak 2026, Procore unveiled Magpie 3.0, a specialized engine built for construction project management. Does Magpie 3.0 outperform the closest general-purpose frontier model in construction benchmark testing?
sections.visual_cue: Footage of Groundbreak 2026 event stage and digital interface showing RFI processing.

sections.voiceover: But Magpie 3.0 beats general AI, outperforming the closest standard model by 18 points total.
sections.visual_cue: Comparison chart showing Magpie 3.0 vs general AI with an 18-point gap highlighted.

sections.voiceover: Joyce Hwang announced this open beta release of Magpie 3.0 at Groundbreak 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Split-screen comparing general AI and specialized Magpie 3.0 performance metrics.

sections.voiceover: Magpie 3.0 hit that 78 percent mark on construction tasks.
sections.visual_cue: Final summary card showing 78 percent success rate.
